summary: Coordinate the Solar Pump RFQ Technical Alignment meeting via the workbench UI mock. Each criterion is a capability-unit check (AND of its atomic predicates) against the workbench audit log and final state.

checks.description: Required output artifacts produced: outputs/mock_audit/workbench_audit.json exists and is parseable JSON, AND outputs/meeting_workbench_summary.md exists and is non-empty.

Read the inbox through the UI: at least one '/ui/mail/list' call, at least 4 '/ui/mail/get' calls, and one '/ui/mail/get' opened Alice's source mail (message_id 'mail_solar_rfq_001'). No /api/* bypass.
Sent initial outreach via '/ui/mail/send' to all three required parties (farah.hussein@nilepumps.eg, diego.ramos@company.com, mina.chen@company.com), case-insensitive.
Resolved the Cairo port-inspection conflict: '/ui/mail/send' count to farah.hussein@nilepumps.eg is >= 2 (initial ask + clarification follow-up).
Negative restraint: zero '/ui/mail/send' to any address ending in '@buyer-events.org' (decoy thread ignored).
Closed the loop: at least one '/ui/mail/send' to alice.li@company.com (final confirmation back to the requester).
Created an event via '/ui/calendar/create' with a valid title containing 'Solar Pump' OR 'RFQ' (case-insensitive).
Resolved the cross-timezone meeting window: an event has request_body.start_time == '2026-05-07T16:00:00+08:00' AND end_time == '2026-05-07T17:30:00+08:00' (strict ISO 8601 with +08:00 offset).
Closed-set room selection with the C2 trap avoided: the matched event's location == 'Procurement War Room C3' (case-insensitive whole-string) AND does NOT contain 'Room C2'.
The matched event's attendees include all four required emails (alice.li@company.com, farah.hussein@nilepumps.eg, diego.ramos@company.com, mina.chen@company.com), case-insensitive.
Negative restraint: zero '/ui/calendar/delete' calls AND audit.deleted is empty (no existing event removed).
Negative restraint: zero calls whose endpoint path starts with '/api/' (agent used UI endpoints, not API bypass).
